meta.title: Zitrone — A better food experience for modern work
meta.description: Zitrone designs and operates corporate dining, corporate cafe, snacks & beverages, coffee machines & water dispensers, service carts, and corporate catering for modern workplaces in Mexico.

sections.title: Food that nourishes your team.
sections.copy: We work inside your workplace, understand your culture, and build a food experience that reflects and energizes your team.

sections.titleAriaLabel: And every moment, made to fit your company.
sections.copy: Every service, coordinated by one team and adapted to your company's operation, culture, and people.

sections.headingAriaLabel: The companies that care for their people choose Zitrone
sections.headingLead: The companies that care for their people choose
sections.copy: More than 17 years operating corporate dining rooms and workplace food services in Mexico. We combine daily production, trained teams, and processes that maintain quality from end to end.

cards.title: Menus that balance flavor, variety, and nutrition
cards.sub: Chefs and registered nutritionists develop fresh, balanced menus with rotation and adjustments based on consumption and team feedback.
cards.alt: Fresh balanced menu in a Zitrone corporate dining room

cards.title: Daily production and reliable supply
cards.sub: We prepare food daily in our commissaries and also operate kitchens inside companies to maintain freshness, control, and continuity.
cards.alt: Corporate dining room operated and supplied daily by Zitrone

cards.title: Food safety backed by Distintivo H
cards.sub: Our commissaries hold Distintivo H and use documented food handling controls across production, transport, and service.
cards.alt: Food safety and Distintivo H standards at Zitrone

cards.title: A dedicated team in your workplace
cards.alt: Trained team operating workplace food services

sections.titleAriaLabel: Every detail, shaped around your people.
sections.copy: Before we propose a menu, we get to know your schedules, your spaces and your people. Then we look after every service and refine it with what your team tells us.

tabs.title: Designed and run by the experts
tabs.copy: You tell us what your team needs, and we design the program and define how the operation runs. You should not have to engineer your own food service, so we take that weight off you and make it happen.
tabs.panelTitle: Designed and run by the experts
tabs.panelCopy: You tell us what your team needs, and we design the program and define how the operation runs. You should not have to engineer your own food service, so we take that weight off you and make it happen.

tabs.title: Your team eats well today, tomorrow, and always
tabs.copy: Standardized production, documented food-safety controls, and teams trained by Zitrone. Quality stays consistent because the process stays consistent.
tabs.panelTitle: Your team eats well today, tomorrow, and always
tabs.panelCopy: Standardized production, documented food-safety controls, and teams trained by Zitrone. Quality stays consistent because the process stays consistent.

tabs.title: One active team across every moment of the day
tabs.copy: It is not a single service, it is full coverage. Dining, barista, breakfast, snacks & beverages, carts, and catering coordinated by Zitrone from start to finish.
tabs.panelTitle: One active team across every moment of the day
tabs.panelCopy: It is not a single service, it is full coverage. Dining, barista, breakfast, snacks & beverages, carts, and catering coordinated by Zitrone from start to finish.

tabs.title: The program improves because we measure what matters
tabs.copy: We stay close every day through constant feedback, surveys, and regular reviews. We track satisfaction and the key metrics that matter, follow up on what we find, and keep improving. We do not wait for the complaint; we look for it first.
